SELECT
  "Mã hóa đơn" AS order_id,
  DATE("Ngày tháng") AS order_date,
  NULL AS customer_id,
  NULL AS customer_name,
  "TongTien" AS total_due,
  ("Trạng thái đơn" = 'hủy đơn') AS is_cancelled,
  FALSE AS no_debt,
  ("Nợ" > 0) AS is_credit
FROM "danh_sach_hoa_don"

SELECT
  "Mã hóa đơn" AS order_id,
  NULL AS pay_date,
  "Đã thu" AS amount
FROM "danh_sach_hoa_don"
WHERE "Đã thu" > 0
